description: Exploit, extending the FreezeOut-style cut. On the current tip (idea A's stack if kept, else E038 plus the pooling cut), also freeze the first group-1 conv block (whitening-output -> 128 conv, pool, BN, GELU) during the 2 epochs at 28 px, exactly as already done at 32 px. In the 28 px graph, detach the block's output before the second group-1 conv. Drop that conv's weight and BN affine params from the 28 px phase's Muon/SGD lists, or zero their lr. BN stays in train mode. Recapture the 28 px graph in build; the graph count is unchanged. conv1 is then trained only in the 5 epochs at 20/24 px. Evaluate dev seeds 3-12 alongside the official run. Log ms/step per phase.
